Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Verification

List the commands or workflows run and their results. For editor changes, include `make extension-host`; for performance claims, include reproducible measurements.

- [ ] `make check` passes.

- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded in `CHANGELOG.md`.
